build.beforeDevCommand: npm run extension && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run extension && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A focus timer where your boat sails a real passage while you work
bundle.longDescription: Leeward turns focus sessions into passages between real harbours. Choose how long to focus, cast off, and make port when the watch is done. Batten down distracting apps and sites while you sail.
